This 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon 392 delivers commanding presence and capability wrapped in striking green with authentic performance engineering.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Xtreme Recon 35 Tire Package with 17 bronze beadlock-capable wheels
- Sky 1-Touch Power Top with removable rear quarter windows
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4 display, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto
- Dual Door Group with premium uppers and MOPAR mirrors
- Integrated off-road camera for enhanced trail awareness
- Trailer Tow Package with Class II receiver hitch
- Heated leather-trimmed bucket seats with heated steering wheel
- Leather steering wheel with wheel-mounted audio controls
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- ParkView rear back-up camera
- Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- SiriusXM Guardian emergency communication system

This Wrangler Unlimited combines serious off-road capability with premium comfort features. The legendary HEMI V8 engine provides substantial power, while the Xtreme Recon package elevates your trail performance with 35-inch tires, reinforced suspension tuned for this platform, and a specialized 4.56 rear axle ratio. The removable Sky Power Top and half doors define the open-air Jeep experience, giving you flexibility for any adventure.

Built for those who demand both capability and refinement, this Rubicon 392 includes thoughtful touches like the integrated off-road camera for obstacle awareness and the hinge-gate reinforcement for durability. The cabin balances rugged utility with comfort through leather seating, heated front seats, dual zone climate control, and premium audio with navigation.

The Trailer Tow Package ensures you're equipped for hauling, while the bronze beadlock wheels and specialized tire package demonstrate this vehicle's commitment to serious off-road performance. Wheel flare extensions and MOPAR upgrades including the satin black grille and doors-off mirror kit showcase authentic MOPAR enhancements.

Every detail reflects Jeep's commitment to capability and style. From the convertible hardtop providing weather protection to the power top quarter window storage bag for convenient stowage, this Wrangler is engineered for versatility. The electronic systems including stability control, traction management, and airbag protection work seamlessly to keep you secure.

This 2022 Rubicon 392 represents the pinnacle of modern Wrangler engineering combining the legendary off-road credibility Jeep owners trust with contemporary technology and comfort. This 2024 Lexus NX 450h+ Luxury in Silver represents a sophisticated choice for drivers seeking refined performance and advanced technology in a compact luxury crossover.

- Quick Charge Cables-Mobile
- 6.6kW On-Board Charger
- Vision Package with Front Cross-Traffic Alert, Panoramic View Monitor, Lane Change Assist, and Steering-Wheel Touch Sensor
- Triple-Beam Headlamps with cornering lamp, high intensity, and auto highbeam
- Digital Inner Mirror
- Smart Phone Convenience Package with wireless charger
- Towing Package (2000 lbs)
- Heated & Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Power Sunroof
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Drive Connect Cloud Navigation with 3-year trial subscription
- Heads-Up Display
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto
- Safety Connect Emergency Communication System with up to 10-year trial subscription
- SiriusXM AM/FM Radio

The hybrid powertrain combines a 2.5L four-cylinder engine with electric motor efficiency, paired with an eCVT transmission and standard all-wheel drive for responsive handling in various conditions. This configuration delivers a balanced driving experience while optimizing fuel economy for daily commuting and longer trips alike.

The Vision Package equips you with comprehensive awareness tools, including a Panoramic View Monitor that displays multiple camera angles, Lane Change Assist, and Front Cross-Traffic Alert. These technologies work together to provide confidence when navigating traffic, changing lanes, or parking. The digital inner mirror and triple-beam headlamps with auto highbeam function enhance visibility and safety throughout your drives.

Interior comfort and convenience are prioritized with heated and ventilated front bucket seats, a heated steering wheel, and power windows and mirrors throughout. The power sunroof brings natural light and airiness to the cabin. The Smart Phone Convenience Package includes wireless charging for seamless device integration, while Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto connectivity keep you connected without cables.

The 6.6kW on-board charger and included Quick Charge Cables-Mobile provide flexibility for home or public charging infrastructure. The standard towing package supports loads up to 2000 pounds, adding practicality for weekend activities or moving needs.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this 2024 Lexus NX 450h+ Luxury firsthand and discuss how it can meet your transportation needs.

A Truck Can Be Practical Without Looking Practical

There's a difference.

You can want a truck because you have projects to finish, things to haul, and weekends that require more than an SUV. But you're also going to look at it sitting in your driveway every day, so there's nothing wrong with wanting one you really like.

There's plenty of substance behind the look, too. Because it's pre-owned, it's also been inspected by our Valley Service team before being offered for sale.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbag, overhead airbag, 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, brake assist, traction control, and an emergency communication system with 911 Connect.

Additional conveniences enhance daily driving with power windows, remote keyless entry, power door mirrors with auto-dimming capability, exterior parking camera, fully automatic headlights with delay-off function, rain sensing wipers, and HomeLink garage door transmitter. The cargo cover, power liftgate, and split-folding rear seat configurations provide flexible storage solutions for various needs.

This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. description: The Toyota Tacoma has built its reputation on durability, resale value, and doing truck things without becoming unnecessarily complicated. This 2021 Toyota Tacoma Limited V6 takes that proven formula and adds the comfort and premium equipment that make it just as enjoyable during the daily commute as it is when there's work to be done. With only 43,411 miles, more than 25,000 miles below market average, this is an especially attractive example of one of the most sought-after midsize pickups on the market. Finished in Midnight Black Metallic over a Black leather interior, the Limited has a clean, upscale appearance that separates it from the more utilitarian Tacoma trims. Polished 18-inch alloy wheels, premium exterior detailing, and the Tacoma's unmistakable stance give it a look that's rugged without sacrificing refinement. Under the hood is Toyota's proven 3.5-liter naturally aspirated V6 producing 278 horsepower, paired with a traditional 6-speed automatic transmission. In a newer truck market increasingly dominated by smaller turbocharged engines, this Tacoma offers the straightforward V6 powertrain many truck buyers specifically seek out. This particular Tacoma is rear-wheel drive, making it an excellent choice for the buyer who doesn't need the additional weight and complexity of 4WD. You still get genuine pickup capability and V6 performance while keeping the truck straightforward and well suited for commuting, hauling, projects, and everyday use. Where this Tacoma really separates itself is the Limited trim. Leather seating, heated front seats, a power driver's seat, power moonroof, dual-zone automatic climate control, HomeLink, remote keyless entry, cruise control, and a telescoping steering wheel give the cabin a level of comfort you don't typically associate with a midsize pickup. Technology is equally impressive. Premium JBL audio provides upgraded sound, while integrated navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, SiriusXM, Bluetooth connectivity, steering wheel-mounted controls, and rear parking sensors provide the modern conveniences you'll appreciate every day. Toyota Safety Sense technology adds another layer of confidence with features including Pre-Collision System, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Departure Alert, and automatic high beams. But one of the biggest reasons people seek out Tacomas isn't found on the equipment list. It's value retention. The Tacoma has developed an exceptional reputation in the pre-owned market, and this generation remains particularly desirable thanks to its naturally aspirated V6, traditional automatic transmission, proven truck platform, and strong enthusiast following. Its resale strength was recognized with an ALG Residual Value Award, reinforcing one of the Tacoma's greatest long-term advantages. Then consider the mileage. At just 43,411 miles, this Tacoma has been driven more than 25,000 miles fewer than the market average. Finding a Limited V6 with this kind of mileage gives the next owner an opportunity to get into a premium-equipped Tacoma with plenty of life ahead of it. description: This 2017 Lexus RC 300 F Sport AWD is one of those Lexus builds that is getting incredibly difficult to find. You get the coveted 3.5-liter naturally aspirated V6, all-wheel drive, must-have F Sport Package, and the super rare white-on-red color combination all in one car. Add the 19-inch F Sport wheels, digital F Sport gauge cluster, heated and ventilated sport seats, heated F Sport steering wheel, sunroof, backup camera, and absolutely stunning condition inside and out, and this is exactly how we want an RC optioned. There are plenty of ordinary RCs for sale, but finding an AWD 3.5-liter F Sport in white over red is an entirely different story.The F Sport Package is absolutely everything to us and completely transforms the RC. You get the more aggressive F Sport front bumper, signature mesh spindle grille, upgraded side skirts, sculpted rear bumper, sportier rear diffuser, exclusive F Sport wheels, sport-tuned suspension, upgraded steering components, incredible F Sport steering wheel, upgraded sport seats, aluminum sport details, black headliner, and F Sport badging throughout. The entire car sits and feels more aggressive than a base RC. This isn't just throwing a couple F Sport badges on the fendersthe exterior, suspension, steering, wheels, seats, steering wheel, and driver's environment all come together to make it feel like a completely different Lexus.One of our favorite parts of the entire F Sport Package is the digital F Sport gauge cluster. The standard RC gauge setup, in our opinion, immediately dates the interior and looks more like something you would expect from the mid-2000s. The F Sport cluster is a completely different experience. The performance-inspired movable digital gauge display transforms the cockpit and still looks like something you could find in a 2026 model-year performance car. Every time you start the vehicle, it's one of those features that reminds you why buying the F Sport matters.Then there is the all-wheel-drive system, which makes this particular RC considerably harder to duplicate. Most people looking for a luxury sport coupe still want something they can confidently drive year-round, and AWD makes a huge difference in Washington rain, cold weather, mountain passes, and winter conditions. You still get the low, sporty coupe driving position and aggressive RC styling, but with the additional confidence and traction of all-wheel drive. AWD RC F Sports are the ones we want.Under the hood is the coveted 3.5-liter naturally aspirated Lexus/Toyota V6. This engine is a huge reason we love these cars because it gives you smooth, linear power without relying on a small turbocharged engine to do all the work. Toyota and Lexus have built an incredible reputation around their naturally aspirated V6 powertrains, and the 3.5-liter combines performance, smoothness, and the long-term durability buyers expect from Lexus. It's an engine that feels just as good cruising down the freeway as it does when you start pushing the RC through the gears.And then there's the white-on-red color combination. This is one of our favorite and hardest-to-find combinations on an RC, especially when you add F Sport and AWD. The white exterior showcases every aggressive line in the F Sport bodywork, while opening the door reveals that incredible red F Sport interior. Lexus got the red rightit has a rich, upscale appearance rather than looking overly bright or cheap, giving the interior the perfect combination of luxury and performance.The heated and ventilated F Sport seats are another major upgrade. The additional bolstering helps hold you in place through corners while remaining extremely comfortable for long-distance driving. Heat them during a cold Washington morning, ventilate them during the summer, and you've got year-round comfort. Combined with the red upholstery and sport-focused design, these are exactly the seats an F Sport coupe should have.The heated F Sport steering wheel is another feature you appreciate ever>

The CR-V is built on a foundation of reliability and practicality. With a 1.5-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission, this model delivers responsive performance while maintaining fuel efficiency at 27 city and 32 highway miles per gallon. The gray exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements any lifestyle.

The cabin welcomes you with leather-trimmed bucket seats, heated for comfort on cooler days. The power-adjustable driver seat with memory ensures your preferred position is always just a button away. Dual-zone automatic climate control lets both driver and passenger set their ideal temperatures independently. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light and fresh air, creating an open and airy atmosphere during your drives.

Safety technology is woven throughout this model. The Collision Mitigation Braking System works actively to help prevent accidents, while the Blind Spot Information System keeps you aware of vehicles in your peripheral vision. A comprehensive airbag system, including dual front and side impact airbags, provides multi-directional protection. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle stability in challenging driving conditions.

Connectivity and convenience features make every journey more enjoyable. The 180-watt audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto provide seamless smartphone integration. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands off the road. The telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position, and the trip computer provides real-time vehicle information.

Practical touches enhance daily ownership. The power liftgate opens automatically when you're carrying groceries or luggage, the rear window wiper keeps visibility clear, and speed-sensitive wipers adapt automatically to changing weather conditions. The exterior parking camera displays vehicle surroundings on your screen, making parking and reversing safer and easier.

This CR-V represents a smart choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped, dependable compact SUV with a verified accident-free history. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the comfort, technology, and capability this vehicle offers firsthand.

description: Every once in a while we find a vehicle that takes you right back in time, and this beautiful 1999 Dodge Ram 1500 Primetime high-top conversion van is one of them. We purchased this incredible van from its original owner in Pennsylvania, and with only 31,000 original miles, its condition truly has to be seen to be appreciated. Finished in beautiful Light Arctic Gray with its original Primetime conversion graphics and blue accent striping, this van has been exceptionally well preserved. The paint has a beautiful shine, the body is straight, the chrome wheels and brightwork look outstanding, and the high-top, running boards and exterior conversion pieces have survived remarkably well. Finding a nearly 30-year-old conversion van that hasn't been used up, rusted away or completely worn out is difficult enough finding a one-owner example with only 31,000 miles in this condition is something entirely different. Inside may be even more impressive. The gorgeous blue velour conversion interior is simply outstanding, with exceptionally clean carpeting, beautiful captain's chairs, woodgrain accents and a rear power sofa that converts into a bed. It still retains its wonderfully period-correct Audiovox television and video system, giving the interior the unmistakable look and feel of a top-of-the-line late-'90s conversion van. The upholstery, headliner, trim and interior appointments show the kind of preservation we almost never see anymore. Power comes from Dodge's tried-and-true 5.2-liter 318 Magnum V8 backed by an automatic transmission. The engine compartment presents beautifully and honestly, and this van has clearly benefited from its incredibly light use and careful ownership. Just as impressive is everything that stayed with it. We have the owner's manuals, original Primetime/conversion literature, Audiovox television and video-system manuals, keys and remotes the kinds of details that make a special low-mileage survivor even more complete. These full-size conversion vans were everywhere in the 1990s, but finding a truly exceptional original example today is becoming increasingly difficult. Most were driven hard, used for family vacations, exposed to winters and eventually worn out. This one escaped that fate. With one owner, only 31,000 original miles, the desirable 318 V8 and an incredibly well-preserved Primetime conversion, this is one of those vehicles that photographs beautifully but is even more impressive when you're standing beside it. Whether you're looking for a nostalgic road-trip vehicle, a remarkably preserved piece of 1990s Americana or simply one of the nicest old-school conversion vans you're likely to find, this one deserves a serious look. description:
This 2019 Mazda CX-9 Grand Touring in Gray delivers the three-row versatility and refined comfort you need for both daily driving and weekend adventures.

- 12-speaker Bose audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof with automatic operation
- Mazda Navigation System with voice command
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated steering wheel and memory driver seat
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels
- Heads-Up Display for enhanced visibility
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Heated rear seats for passenger comfort
- Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension
- Auto high-beam headlights with rain-sensing wipers
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Three-row seating with split-folding rear seats

The Grand Touring trim provides thoughtful touches that make every drive more enjoyable. Climate zones throughout the cabin keep all passengers comfortable, whether you're heating seats on cold mornings or cooling them during summer drives. The available heated rear seats ensure everyone stays comfortable on longer trips. Premium materials like leather seating surfaces and a leather-wrapped steering wheel elevate the interior experience.

This CX-9 combines practical utility with driver-focused technology. The Mazda Navigation System gets you where you need to go, while voice command and steering wheel-mounted controls keep your focus on the road. The Heads-Up Display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, reducing distractions during driving.

Performance and safety work together in this three-row crossover. The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine with 6-speed automatic transmission delivers capable everyday performance, while all-wheel drive provides confident traction in varying conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control and traction control help you drive with confidence. The comprehensive airbag system, including side-impact and roll-sensing overhead airbags, provides layered protection.

With seating for seven and flexible cargo configurations, this CX-9 adapts to your lifestyle. The split-folding rear seat gives you options whether you're transporting passengers or maximizing cargo space. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient, and the roof rack rails provide options for additional storage.

With 64,649 miles on the odometer and regular maintenance behind it, this Grand Touring offers proven reliability at an excellent value. Come see this three-row crossover in person and discover why the CX-9 remains a popular choice for families and active individuals who refuse to compromise between style, comfort, and capability.

Air conditioning
Steering-wheel controls
USB connectivity

Its compact dimensions make it easy to maneuver and park while still providing a comfortable four-door interior.

The exterior design gives the Elantra a polished appearance that works well for commuting, work, school, or everyday errands.

Safety Features

The Elantra includes important safety equipment such as a rearview camera, stability control, traction control, tire-pressure monitoring, and multiple airbags.

These features provide additional confidence during everyday driving while helping make the Elantra a practical choice for commuters and families.

This 2015 Volvo XC60 T6 R-Design Platinum AWD delivers Scandinavian design and engineering excellence in a refined midsize luxury SUV that commands attention on any road.

- 3.0L I6 Turbocharged engine with Polestar
- 6-Speed Automatic transmission with Geartronic
- All-Wheel Drive
- R-Design Sport Leather Seating Surfaces
- Power moonroof
- Navigation System with Real Time Traffic
- Volvo Premium Sound System with 12 speakers and SIRIUS satellite radio
- Xenon high intensity discharge headlights
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear with Rear Parking Sensors
- 20 Ixion II Alloy Wheels
- Dual front zone automatic temperature control
- Power adjustable front seats with memory functions
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Anti-whiplash front head restraints with occupant sensing airbags
- Roof rack with rails

The R-Design Platinum trim represents Volvo's commitment to performance and luxury, combining turbocharged power with all-wheel drive capability. The 3.0-liter inline-six engine with Polestar tuning delivers responsive acceleration paired with a six-speed automatic transmission featuring manual Geartronic control for driver engagement. You'll appreciate the connected technologies that make daily driving easier, including the premium sound system with satellite radio, real-time traffic navigation, and smartphone integration through the Volvo Sensus platform.

Inside, the R-Design sport leather seats provide both comfort and visual appeal, enhanced by heated door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, and a power moonroof that opens your view to the sky. The power liftgate and split-folding rear seats offer practical versatility for your needs, whether you're managing daily commutes or weekend adventures. Memory seat functions ensure your preferred driving position is always just one touch away.

Safety remains central to the Volvo experience. This XC60 features dual front impact airbags, side impact protection, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a four-wheel independent suspension system work together to maintain confidence through varied driving conditions. The parking camera and rear sensors provide added awareness during backing maneuvers.

The exterior presentation speaks to purposeful design. Crystal white pearl paint catches the light beautifully, complemented by Xenon headlights with auto-dimming capability and rear fog lights. The roof rack with rails and body-color bumpers complete the refined appearance. Rain-sensing wipers and automatic headlights adapt to changing weather conditions without distraction.

We invite you to experience this capable luxury SUV firsthand. The combination of Volvo's engineering heritage, the turbocharged performance, and the comprehensive feature set makes this XC60 a compelling choice for discerning drivers seeking a midsize SUV that balances sophistication with substance.

This 2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trailhawk 4xe in Black combines capability with modern technology, offering a refined driving experience for those seeking both performance and practicality.

- Hands-Free Power Liftgate

The Trailhawk 4xe is built for those who value both comfort and capability. The adaptive suspension system adjusts to various driving conditions, while the heavy-duty suspension framework ensures stability across different terrains. All-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling provides a composed ride whether navigating city streets or tackling rougher paths.

Inside, the cabin reflects a commitment to comfort and connectivity. Capri Leather and Suede seats with heating and ventilation functions keep occupants comfortable in any season. The steering wheel includes heating capability, while the power adjustable driver and passenger seats with memory functions cater to individual preferences. The Uconnect 5 Navigation system with a 10.1-inch display integrates seamlessly with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio through 10 premium speakers.

Safety and convenience are prioritized throughout. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist contribute to confident handling, while auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensitive wipers adapt to driving conditions automatically.

Located at Southern of Norfolk, 2747 N Military Hwy, Norfolk VA (across from the airport), this Grand Cherokee Trailhawk 4xe awaits your inspection. We invite you to experience its blend of luxury, technology, and capability firsthand.

This 2020 Hyundai Palisade Limited in Black presents a well-maintained three-row family vehicle ready to serve your transportation needs. With 75,822 miles on the odometer, this AWD model demonstrates responsible maintenance and consistent performance. The V6 engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC delivers solid capability, achieving 19 MPG city and 24 MPG highway.

The interior reflects the Limited trim's focus on comfort and refinement. Premium Nappa leather seat trim wraps heated and ventilated front bucket seats, while the power passenger seat adjusts to individual preferences. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light. Climate control extends throughout the vehicle with front dual-zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning, ensuring passenger comfort across all three rows. The heated steering wheel adds convenience during colder months.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. Harman/Kardon® premium audio with 12 speakers delivers quality sound throughout the cabin. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto provide seamless smartphone integration, while SiriusXM satellite radio and the navigation system keep you entertained and on course. Safety and visibility are priorities throughout this Palisade. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags protect occupants across all three rows. - Front-wheel drive
- 31 city/39 highway MPG fuel efficiency
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow

The exterior presents a sharp appearance with its black finish and 18-inch gloss black alloy wheels that give the Sport model its distinctive look. The body-color bumpers maintain a cohesive design, while the heated door mirrors and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality add practical convenience to daily driving.

Inside, the cabin balances comfort with modern convenience. The front bucket seats with cloth and leatherette surfaces provide support for daily commutes, while the split-folding rear seat gives you flexibility for cargo and passengers. The leather steering wheel and shift knob add touches of refinement, and the telescoping tilt steering wheel ensures you can find your ideal driving position. The illuminated entry and front reading lights make getting in and out easier in low-light conditions.

Technology plays a key role in this Civic's appeal. The integration of Apple CarPlay and Android Auto means your smartphone connects seamlessly to the vehicle. The 180-watt audio system with eight speakers delivers clear sound, while steering wheel-mounted controls keep you focused on the road. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful information at a glance.

Safety features are comprehensive and designed to work together. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow helps during stop-and-go traffic, while the Blind Spot Information System provides awareness of vehicles you might not see. Electronic stability control, traction control, and the four-wheel independent suspension work to keep you connected to the road. The rear parking camera adds confidence when backing up, and the emergency communication system through HondaLink provides additional peace of mind.

The fuel efficiency of 31 city and 39 highway MPG means fewer fill-ups and lower fuel costs over time, making this Sport model practical for daily driving.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this 2026 Civic Sport firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find the right vehicle for your needs.

description:
This 2015 Toyota 4Runner SR5 Premium offers the capability and comfort you need for both daily driving and weekend adventures.

- Cargo Cross Bars
- Rigid Running Boards
- SofTex-Trimmed 50/50 Split Fold-Flat 3rd Row with sliding 2nd row
- Power Tilt & Slide Moonroof with Sunshade
- Entune Premium Audio with Navigation and SiriusXM
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Power adjustment
- Leather-Trimmed Steering Wheel
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- 17 6-Spoke Alloy Wheels
- Body-Color Heated Mirrors
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Front Fog Lights
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS

The 4Runner is built on a proven platform designed to handle demanding conditions. Its 4.0L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and 4WD system provides the performance characteristics owners expect from this model. The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that suits a variety of settings.

Interior appointments reflect the SR5 Premium designation. Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment ensure comfort across seasons and driving distances. The leather-trimmed steering wheel and shift knob add refinement, while the SofTex synthetic leather seat trim resists wear and staining. The sliding second row with one-touch access to the third row maximizes flexibility for passengers and cargo configuration.

Technology features include Entune Premium Audio with integrated Navigation and SiriusXM satellite radio capability. The power moonroof with sunshade brings natural light into the cabin. Climate control features include air conditioning, rear window defroster, and heated mirrors for year-round driving comfort.

Safety equipment includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and brake assist support confident handling in various driving scenarios. The exterior parking camera rear assists with backing and parking maneuvers.

The 4Runner combines utility with everyday livability, making it a practical choice for buyers who value three-row seating, cargo capacity, and 4WD capability in a vehicle designed for long-term ownership and reliability.

This 2015 Ram 1500 Big Horn in gray combines capable truck performance with practical comfort for work and everyday driving.

- Power 10-way driver seat with lumbar adjustment
- Remote start and security system
- Uconnect 5.0 touchscreen with Bluetooth and voice command
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls
- Electric shift-on-demand 4WD transfer case
- 8-speed automatic transmission
- Heated exterior mirrors
- Fog lamps with automatic headlights
- Premium cloth bucket seats with full-length floor console
- 60/40 split-folding rear seat
- Chrome bumpers and bright grille
- 115V auxiliary power outlet
- Class IV receiver hitch

The Ram 1500 Big Horn is built to handle demanding tasks while providing the comfort you need during long drives. The 3.6L V6 engine delivers dependable power, returning 16 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway. Four-wheel drive gives you confidence in various weather and terrain conditions, while the electric shift-on-demand transfer case lets you switch between two-wheel and four-wheel drive as needed.

Inside, you'll find well-appointed seating with power adjustments and a full-length floor console that maximizes storage space. The Uconnect 5.0 system keeps you connected with Bluetooth integration and voice command capability, while steering wheel controls let you manage audio and calls without taking your hands off the wheel. Remote start means you can warm up or cool down the cabin before you get in.

Safety is a priority with this truck. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to help maintain grip, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you strong stopping power when you need it.

The 20-inch aluminum chrome-clad wheels add visual appeal, while practical features like heated mirrors, fog lamps, and a rear step bumper enhance functionality. A full-size temporary spare tire ensures you can continue on your way if needed. The Class IV receiver hitch opens up towing possibilities for trailers and accessories.

This Big Horn has the features and durability you expect from Ram, ready for whatever comes next. Visit us to experience it firsthand.
